declared difference (truth fix T1, code view): the awk cut each line at its first "//" (inside a string too) and
read block comments and string literals as code, so a commented-out singletonList (A) and coordination names that
live only in a comment or a string (B) made false WARNs, and the field after "http://" was hidden (C). The lint
reads code with comments blanked and literal contents removed now.
